title: Exports of the Calvenza region by sector, 2024 to 2025
bodyMd: The chamber of commerce of the Calvenza region publishes the following figures for the four sectors that account for all of the region's exports. "Exports 2024" is the value of the sector's exports in 2024, in millions of euros. "Change" is the percentage change in the value of the sector's exports between 2024 and 2025; a negative figure is a fall. "Exporting firms" is the number of firms in the sector that exported anything in 2025.

data.caption: Calvenza region, exports by sector: value in 2024, percentage change between 2024 and 2025, and number of exporting firms in 2025.

accessibilityText: A table of four rows and four columns. The columns are sector, value of exports in 2024 in millions of euros, percentage change in the value of exports between 2024 and 2025, and number of exporting firms in 2025. Machinery: 700 million euros in 2024, change plus 12 per cent, 140 exporting firms. Food and drink: 300 million euros, change plus 30 per cent, 410 exporting firms. Textiles: 500 million euros, change minus 22 per cent, a fall, 260 exporting firms. Chemicals: 500 million euros, change plus 20 per cent, 55 exporting firms. The four sectors account for all of the region's exports, which totalled 2,000 million euros in 2024. An accompanying bar chart plots the 2024 export values only, one bar per sector, tallest for Machinery at 700 million euros and shortest for Food and drink at 300 million euros.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional region, written for this item set. The 2024 values sum to a round 2,000 million euros and every percentage change produces a whole-number increment, so the questions can be worked by hand. The sector with the largest percentage rise, the sector with the largest 2024 value and the sector with the largest change in magnitude are three different sectors, and none of them is the sector with the largest rise in euros. The exporting-firms column is deliberately superfluous. Not derived from any real region, dataset or published test item.
